look_here_first: Low sprawling sensitive-briar with twice-compound leaves that fold when touched and pink-lavender globose flower heads.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Mimosa species have bipinnate leaves and globose heads of many tiny flowers; several species have touch-sensitive leaflets.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: up to about 3 pairs of pinnae

lookalikes.differences: More herbaceous and mat-forming than woody M. borealis and M. texana.
